findings.title: Cold-boot deep link to VacancyDetail/VacancyHandoff silently drops the leaderboard response - session-restore and demo-entry fetch paths never set leaderboard_vacancy_id, so the new match guard falls through to the no-op arm
findings.location: client/src/client.gleam:1046-1090 (ApiReturnedSession VacancyDetail arm), 5839-5934 (enter_demo / demo_entry_effects), guard at 2081-2112; set-sites only at 1981, 2068, 5228
findings.evidence: Session-restore model update sets `vacancy_detail_request_id: Some(id)` but no `leaderboard_vacancy_id`; guard requires `case result, model.leaderboard_vacancy_id { Ok(response), Some(current) if current == vacancy_id ->`. model.initial has `leaderboard_vacancy_id: None` (model.gleam:644). init comments state modem.init does NOT dispatch at boot, so handle_browser_change (the only set-site reachable on boot, 5228) never fires on a cold load.
findings.detail: Refreshing the browser on /vacancies/<id> (or deep-linking into the demo vacancy) leaves the leaderboard stuck at NotAsked forever - the response arrives tagged with the right id but the guard compares against None and drops it. Live-product regression introduced by the r2 B2 fix. Verified against the worktree: the only set-sites are AppRequestedVacancyDetail (1981), AppRequestedLeaderboard (2068), and handle_browser_change (5228).
findings.recommended_fix: Set `leaderboard_vacancy_id: Some(id)` (and leaderboard: Loading) in the ApiReturnedSession VacancyDetail/Handoff model update and in enter_demo's request-id block (or wherever demo_entry_effects' fetches are modelled), so cold-boot responses pass the guard.

findings.title: ApiReturnedLeaderboard Error arm ignores the vacancy-id guard - a late error from vacancy A clobbers vacancy B's board with Failure (B2 residual)
findings.evidence: Error(err), _ -> #( Model(..model, leaderboard: Failure(error_page_copy(err, copy.CtxApplicationsLoadList))), effect.none() )
findings.detail: The guard covers only Ok responses. Sequence: A's fetch in flight -> navigate to B -> A's request fails late -> B's board flips to Failure copy until B's own response lands. Transient but user-visible; the refresh handler ignores late errors entirely and this arm should match.
findings.recommended_fix: Guard the Error arm on `model.leaderboard_vacancy_id == Some(vacancy_id)` (or drop late errors like ApiReturnedLeaderboardRefresh does).
